title: the-verbatim-is-checked-against-the-transcript
intention: `cairn ruling open` measures, at intake, whether each line of `the_ruling_verbatim` occurs byte-identically among the human messages of the session transcript, and records what it found.
why: THE FIELD EVERY OTHER FIELD IS CHECKED AGAINST IS ITSELF UNCHECKED. The door refuses `the_ruling_verbatim` empty, refuses non-string entries, and DERIVES confirmation from a `RULED` marker found inside it — three mechanisms that all trust the field's content, and the content is typed by CC. The lived symptom, measured at n=1 on 2026-08-14 and not hypothetical: the packet for 2026-08-14-tools-and-machines-remember-under-their-holder passed every shape refusal, passed `verify` green, and got auto-confirmed — while its first verbatim line was a TIDIED version of what Akien wrote. A clause of his quote had been elided to '...', his paragraph breaks collapsed into single spaces, and a full stop added that he never typed: 631 characters where he had written 738. Nothing in the system could see it. Akien saw it, by pasting his own terminal log back and making CC compare. A reading checked against a paraphrase of his words is a reading checked against CC, which is the exact circularity edge (f) was built to end — reopened one layer down.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured. 'these are his words' is today an unmeasured claim carrying a confirmation.
Law 4 — a rule enforced by physics, not policy. 'quote him exactly' is discipline, and discipline is what this component keeps proving it cannot rely on.
Law 7 — permanent in records of truth. A decision record IS a record of truth; a tidied quote inside one is an error that got collapsed into a coherent shape.
Law 10 — nothing in the system is immeasurable. The session transcript is JSON on disk and greppable, so 'we have not built the measurement yet' is the true state here and the only acceptable one.
ruling 2026-08-13-tools-have-users-not-owners and every ruling since — all of them rest on this field.

falsifier.proves_green: The instrument: parse the session JSONL, collect the human-authored messages (both `type:"user"` string content and `attachment.queued_command` entries whose `origin.kind` is `human` — mid-turn interjections arrive as the latter and are NOT user-role turns, which is itself a thing the first attempt got wrong), and test each verbatim line for byte-identical membership. Proven by a tooth that TIDIES a known-good line — elide a clause, collapse a newline — and requires the check to catch it. A hollow build passes by substring-matching the raw escaped JSON text, which reports False on a line that IS his because of `\n` and `\uXXXX` escaping; the proof must parse, never grep.
falsifier.proves_red: RED if: (1) a tidied line is reported as matched; (2) an exact line is reported as unmatched because the reader grepped raw bytes instead of parsing records; (3) a mid-turn interjection ('SO RULED' arriving beside a tool result) is reported unmatched because the reader only looked at user-role turns; (4) an unmatched line silently BLOCKS a ruling Akien spoke away from the terminal — the failure mode that would make him stop recording rulings, which is worse than the defect.
falsifier.horizon: Next time anyone is inside cairn/machines/ruling. NOT urgent-in-anger: every ruling in the store today reads correctly, and the one corrupted line is repaired. It IS load-bearing, because the store now holds 45 rulings whose authority rests entirely on this field and the number only grows.

chart_notes.orient: The transcript is at ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/<session-id>.jsonl and the door does not know which session it is in — that unknown is why this rests at THINKME rather than BUILDME. Two shapes of human message live in there and BOTH count: `type:"user"` records with string content, and `attachment.queued_command` records whose `origin.kind` is "human". Mid-turn interjections — "SO RULED" arriving beside a tool result — are ONLY the second kind, so a reader that walks user-role turns alone will call his ruling a fabrication.
chart_notes.constrain: The bound is Akien's and is not CC's to assume: an unmatched line must not become an unrecordable ruling. He rules in person, in other sessions, after a rotation. CC's proposal is a door-stamped MEASUREMENT the hook can report, never a refusal — but that is a proposal, and the shape is his to settle before BUILDME.
chart_notes.validate: The tooth that a hollow build fails: take a line known to be his, TIDY it the way CC did — elide a clause to '...', collapse a paragraph break to a space — and require the check to catch it. The second tooth is the inverse and it already bit once: substring-matching the RAW jsonl text reports False on a line that IS his, because the file stores \n and \uXXXX escaped. Parse records; never grep bytes.
